password-manager.body:
**Offline password manager** — A small, focused password tool. Offline password manager does one job properly, runs offline, and keeps your data on your device.

**Why it exists**
Password is one of those small irritations that eats a little attention every
single day. This is a single-purpose tool for it: no setup, no sign-in, no
network calls. Open the page and it works.

**What the free edition does**
Everything you need for the job itself. It runs straight in the browser and
your data never leaves your device.

**Get it**
- Free: https://tbougnar.github.io/Slingshot-Tools/apps/password-manager-basic/

One new tool lands every month. Use `/vote` in the server to pick what comes
next.
